webNotSetUp: Google sign-in is not set up on this server yet; you can connect once the administrator adds the Google OAuth client.
clientHint: In the Google Cloud Console create an OAuth client of the "Desktop app" type, turn on the Search Console API and the Google Analytics Data and Admin APIs, then enter the client's id and secret.
continueInBrowser: Continue in your browser; it shows here once Google grants access.
waitingForGoogle: Waiting for Google in your browser…
privacy: Read-only access is asked for. Data comes straight from Google and is free; the access token is kept encrypted with your keys.
chooseFirst: Choose and save the project's Search Console property first.
free: Free: Google data uses no credits.
started: The update started; its progress shows here and in the sidebar.
limited: Google sampled or withheld some Analytics data
dailyHint: Clicks and impressions of this period; the dashed line is the same days of the period before
noDays: No daily data for this period.
trackedLine: {seen} of {total} tracked keywords appear in Search Console
auditLine: {n} pages with clicks were broken, redirected or not indexable in the latest audit
noAudit: No site audit yet; page states show after an audit.
cannibalisedLine: {n} queries have more than one of your pages competing
queriesHint: The top 500 queries by clicks; changes against the period before
nearTopHint: Queries with an average position of 4–20 and enough impressions: a small improvement can bring more clicks.
trackHint: The selected queries go to Rank tracking
manyPages: {n} pages are shown for this query
pagesHintAnalytics: The top 500 pages by clicks, with their organic sessions in Analytics
cannibalisedTitle: Pages competing for the same query
cannibalisedHint: Queries for which more than one of your pages is shown; bringing them onto one page can strengthen its position
queryPagesHint: The page shown for this query
queryPagesMany: {n} of your pages are shown for this query
emptyText: Press "Update now": the chosen period and the one before it are read.
connectText: Connect your Google account to see Search Console queries and pages for {domain}, and Google Analytics organic traffic if you like.
pagesAuditHint: Badges show how the latest site audit saw the page.
compareYearLimit: Up to {n} days compare with a year before (Search Console keeps 16 months).
periodLineYear: {start} – {end}, compared with the same days a year before ({before})
brandHint: Counted as brand: {terms} (the project's brand names and domain)
brandShareHint: Of the clicks from listed queries
exportAllHint: Every row the last sync read
